items.raw_excerpt: Can you imagine dating someone who agrees with everything you say without you ever having to contribute to the relationship? According to two University of Waterloo researchers, that’s what it’s like dating an AI companion.

They found that an AI boyfriend agrees with everything you say without you ever having to contribute to the relationship. The study examines how people experience romantic connections with artificial intelligence.
